The printed expression does not cancel for its advertised A,B; independently at λ=1,c=5/13,ρ=1/5 and k=1, it gives −4/13 instead of zero. The complete new RESULT.md fixes the forcing to +2k−Δ, proves Lh=Δ−2k with A=−1/Δ, B=1−(1+λ)/Δ², and then exact cancellation. Gram orthogonality yields tridiagonal M-matrix with row excess ≥1 and l∞ inverse bound ≤1; remaining residual ρ^k n^-2P2(k)+ρ^k n^-3P3(k) is uniformly O(n^-2). Thus all-k coefficient and uniform |z|≥R>1 exterior expansion follow. Independent rational k=1..6 checks gave zero corrected n^-1 coefficient; independent tridiagonal solves for n=30,150,600 gave n² absolute first-coefficient errors around 0.095. The corrected first-order term is a nonzero rational function and all hypotheses λ>0,0<c<1/2 are retained.
